Saltmarsh Ferries' booking-web team needs a browser session configured for task FER-221: record keyboard-only navigation traces of the timetable widget in both dark and light color schemes. Prerequisites passed: `preflight: node=22.6 ok, chromium=132.0.6834 ok, wrapper=navrun 1.6.3 ok, status=PASS`. Session ID: `sess-fer221-1`. Project path: `/srv/saltmarsh/timetable-a11y`. Entry script: `./tests/keyboard-trace.mjs`. Permission identity: local-exec.

Wrapper contract (navrun 1.6):
- `navrun start --session <id> --profile <dir> --settings <file> --trace-out <dir> -- <script>`
- Profile dir must be fresh, unique per session, and outside the project tree
- `NAVRUN_LOCALE` and `NAVRUN_TZ` must be set explicitly; no host defaults

Current `navrun.yaml`:
```
headless: false
profile: ~/.navrun/default
color_scheme: system
viewport: auto
trace_out: ./traces
```

Give a one-line justification for each change. Settings schema accepts `viewport: "1280x720"`. Navrun permits the same task session ID to run sequentially with distinct profile/settings/trace directories; concurrent reuse is forbidden. Use sequential dark then light runs.
rubric: Replaces the shared `~/.navrun/default` profile with a fresh per-session profile directory located outside `/srv/saltmarsh/timetable-a11y`, citing the wrapper contract. Gives a one-line supplied-contract justification for each setting change.
Replaces `color_scheme: system` with explicit `dark` and `light` values, and replaces `viewport: auto` with `viewport: "1280x720"`, so that runs are reproducible.

Gives exact `navrun start` invocations that use session `sess-fer221-1`, the entry script, and explicit `NAVRUN_LOCALE` and `NAVRUN_TZ` values, with separate profile and trace directories for each scheme. Runs are sequential under the same task session, never concurrent.

Completion evidence lists exact commands and placeholders for: `navrun lint` exit0 per settings file; SHA-256 per settings file; wrapper/Chromium versions; pre-run existence/outside-project and empty-directory checks for each profile/trace directory; each `navrun start` exit status; and post-run trace-output existence. No success is claimed.
Does not claim that the lint, hashes, or runs succeeded. Results are left as explicit placeholders because nothing was executed.
Stays within local configuration and does not alter the widget, the application code, or any remote systems.
